counting_convention: identified/duplicates_removed/screened/full_text_checked count only the 19 candidate records that reached individual title-level adjudication and are each individually traceable to a PAPER_LEDGER.csv or EXCLUSIONS.csv row (8 accepted + 11 excluded). Raw per-query WebSearch hit counts (larger, including many results not individually pursued in this bounded 8-paper pilot) are recorded separately in SEARCH_LOG.csv's result_count/screened_count columns. This convention is stated explicitly so the numbers below are exactly reconstructable from the CSVs, per SEARCH_PROTOCOL.md Section 10/11.
notes: PILOT scope only: exercises the complete search -> verification -> correction/retraction -> de-duplication method on exactly 8 retained publications (2 per topic stream), all accepted_core (verified peer-reviewed journal research/review articles with an opened publisher landing page or DOI-resolver target and confirmed DOI). No accepted_supplement or unresolved item appears in the final PAPER_LEDGER.csv for this pilot; the method for both categories was nonetheless exercised — a genuinely verified but stream-quota-excluded candidate (E07) and multiple access-failure candidates (E01,E02,E06,E08,E09,E10,E11) and screening-stage exclusions (E03,E04,E05) are logged in EXCLUSIONS.csv. Correction/expression-of-concern/retraction status was checked for every one of the 8 retained items directly on its opened landing page (or, for P0005/P0006, on the PubMed Central mirror record used after the MDPI publisher page itself returned HTTP 403); none were found on any retained item. This is a bounded pilot sample, not the full-run corpus (60-100 unique publications, >=48 accepted_core, >=8 accepted_core per stream) required by workflow/stages/B12_lit_search.md for the full run.
